shipsets.title: Build-State Pack v0
shipsets.credible_home: Cargo-adjacent companion repo or funded lab build-infra team
import_surfaces: optional unstable cargo report timing/rebuild/session data with caveat labels
proving_grounds: local iterative cargo check/build loops on a medium workspace
Cargo vs Rust Analyzer contention cases
CI-local comparisons with differing target/build-dir placement
nightly -Zbuild-dir-new-layout runs on the same project
maintenance_burdens: adapter churn around unstable cargo report surfaces
schema evolution for packs and diffs
proof fixtures for mixed local/CI environments
refused_expansions: hosted build-health dashboard sold as the whole answer
exit_criteria: repeatable packs across at least three real proving grounds
useful diffs on rebuild/layout changes without false certainty
explicit support posture for stable-only versus unstable-enhanced runs
at least one maintained migration receipt for build-dir-layout churn
notes: Strongest first build in the archive.
Must preserve stable-only and unstable-enhanced postures explicitly.
Should deepen the build-regression triage journey, not widen into a replacement build system.

shipsets.title: Package Intake Review Kit v0
shipsets.credible_home: security-adjacent operator team or release-engineering group
import_surfaces: manifest, lockfile, and dependency graph data
optional capability-analysis and provenance receipts when available
proving_grounds: one crates.io publish flow using Trusted Publishing
one crates.io publish flow still using tokens
one alternate-registry path with explicit uncertainty
one dependency-intake review against a recent incident class
refused_expansions: mandatory gate for all Rust package use
central service that replaces local operator judgment
exit_criteria: successful use across multiple route profiles
repeatable incident drills with explicit local decisions
clear waiver, quarantine, and escalation histories
optional capability/provenance imports that improve decisions without becoming theater
notes: Urgent operator seam; should stay local-first and route-aware.
Should import service truth but never masquerade as service truth itself.
Best proof is repeated real review decisions, not a universal score.

shipsets.title: Debug Acceptance Matrix v0
shipsets.credible_home: cross-tool steward group or coalition of debugger-adjacent maintainers
import_surfaces: debugger-native session transcripts or structured exports where available
fixture build receipts from Cargo builds
bounded tuple descriptors across debugger, OS, architecture, and runtime
proof_artifacts: diff when a tuple changes over time
proving_grounds: small Linux tuple set with at least two debuggers
one Windows tuple with materially different expression or visualizer behavior
one async fixture family where stepping and task identity are visible pain points
one regression replay after a debugger or toolchain change
maintenance_burdens: fixture drift as Rust internals evolve
exit_criteria: explicit unsupported-state receipts for yellow and red space
at least one meaningful regression-detection loop
enough maintained tuple cards that decisions stop depending on memory
notes: This is the clearest deepen-shaped shipset rather than a first-build winner over Build-State Evidence.
The corpus should normalize outcomes, not force one debugger export format as canon.
Best payoff is issue handoff and regression visibility.

shipsets.title: Safety Readiness Cards v0
shipsets.credible_home: consortium or foundation-backed steward group with adopter participation
import_surfaces: official Rust target, release, goals, and issue references
illustrative adopter receipts with non-universal posture
proof_artifacts: readiness card pack for a target or program area
stewardship note naming owner shape and renewal burden
proving_grounds: one target-readiness card set for a narrow target family
one dependency-lifecycle playbook for a higher-criticality tightening path
one FFI or interop evidence recipe
one async-runtime requirements sketch clearly marked as requirements work
maintenance_burdens: host-shape coordination across companies and maintainers
refused_expansions: generic claim that Rust is ready for all safety-critical use
single tool claiming to solve qualification
exit_criteria: small but maintained card corpus with renewal receipts
at least one credible steward coalition
clear evidence boundaries that survive higher-assurance review
notes: Best first proof is maintained cards used in real review, not any certification claim.
Should stay stewardship-heavy even if the first artifact family is modest.
